Working Process

Our Process

Contact Us
1.

Discovery

The discovery phase is where we learn more about what you’re looking for in a website. Once we have an idea of what you’d like, we move on to the next part of the process.

2.

Design

This is where we determine the layout for each page, the fonts and colors used, and more. We’ll take into account the type of audience you have as well as your company logo and branding to make sure the website fits the business perfectly.

3.

Development

Once we have everything figured out, we start the development of the website. This is where we build the entire website, including the homepage, landing pages, pages about your company or products and services, and any other pages that might be needed.

4.

Deliver

The website will need to be tested to make sure it works properly and there aren’t any dead links, photos that don’t appear, or plugins that don’t work properly. Once you have approved the final design and testing is complete, your website will be live and ready to start helping you bring in more leads.
